visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair wearing a white textured long-sleeve shirt sits behind a wooden table. She holds a silver smartphone in her left hand and points toward it with her right index finger. Behind her is a beige sofa with an orange blanket draped over the side against a white brick wall. Lighting is bright and even. (2) Scene cuts to a screen recording of the App Store showing the 'Whoscall' application page. The interface displays a green icon, a '4.8' star rating, and 'Finalist' badge for 'Cultural Impact'. A green highlight box appears around the version number '4.7.2' in the 'What's New' section to emphasize the update. (3) Returns to the woman at the table. She holds the phone up, showing its back to the camera, and gestures animatedly while speaking. Her facial expressions are expressive, with wide eyes and a smiling mouth. The background remains the same living room setting with soft indoor lighting and clean composition. (4) Scene cuts to a screen recording of the iOS 'Settings' menu. A green digital arrow navigates from 'General' to 'VPN & Device Management,' then into the 'VPN' menu where 'Whoscall Web Check' is shown as 'Connected'. The interface colors are standard white and grey with blue accents and green toggle switches. (5) Transition to a screen recording within the Whoscall app interface. The user navigates to the 'Web Check' page and toggles a green switch for 'Auto-check' to the off position. The screen displays a green globe icon at the top and statistics about checked websites and blocked numbers in a clean layout. (6) Final shot returns to the woman sitting at the wooden table. She holds the phone next to her face, showing the screen to the camera. She has a triumphant expression and a wide smile. While no one else is visible in the frame, she looks toward the side off-camera as she speaks.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 你也跟我一樣. (2) [Subtitle]: LINE 通話沒聲音嗎. (3) [Subtitle]: 刪除重新安裝 LINE 都沒有用. (4) [Subtitle]: 原本還以為是手機壞了. (5) [Subtitle]: 結果原來兇手是這個. (6) [Subtitle]: 如果你有裝 Whoscall. (7) [Subtitle]: 現在最新的版本已經是 4.7.2 囉. (8) [Subtitle]: 還沒有更新的人記得更新. (9) [Subtitle]: 除了 Whoscall 沒更新以外. (10) [Subtitle]: 還要檢查它是不是偷偷幫你開了 VPN. (11) [Subtitle]: 不小心跟 LINE 通話打架了. (12) [Subtitle]: 點開手機設定. (13) [Subtitle]: 按一般. (14) [Subtitle]: 再到 VPN 與裝置管理. (15) [Subtitle]: 點進 VPN. (16) [Subtitle]: 就可以確認 VPN 是不是連到了 Whoscall. (17) [Subtitle]: 至於如何關掉呢. (18) [Subtitle]: 就到 Whoscall 裡. (19) [Subtitle]: 按進網站檢查. (20) [Subtitle]: 把自動檢查關掉. (21) [Subtitle]: LINE 通話就可以聽到聲音囉. (22) [Subtitle]: 欸!? [Variety]: 欸!?. (23) [Subtitle]: 我 LINE 好了耶. (24) [Subtitle]: 所以不是手機壞掉. (25) [Subtitle]: 是被 VPN 擋住了啦.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a practical tech tutorial designed to solve a common user complaint: LINE calls having no sound on iPhones. It identifies a specific conflict with the 'Whoscall' app's VPN feature as the culprit and provides a clear, high-energy walkthrough on how to update or adjust settings to fix the issue.
